description: Establish the baseline for Public/frontend-v6 and write the analysis document that grounds the fixes. Confirm the app builds and tests pass on the current checkout, then produce a written inventory of (a) how avatars are chosen in the list vs the detail card and which field carries the photo, (b) how/where the Contributor Details card is opened and positioned per skin, and (c) every horizontal/RTL scroller in v6 and how each of the five skins uses it. This feature changes no product code; it de-risks the two implementation features that follow.
steps: Ensure PATH prepends nvm node: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH". Confirm `node --version` is v22.23.2.

From Public/frontend-v6, if node_modules is absent run `npm ci`. Then run the exact CI gates and record output: `npm run check`, `npm test`, `npm run build`. All must pass (baseline was 271 tests passing + build OK).

Read src/lib/api/derive.ts and confirm the Contributor interface field carrying the photo (it is `photo: string`, public R2 URL or '' when none, ~line 158). Note the helpers exported from src/lib/utils/format.ts: initials(), avatarGradient(), fmt().

Read the four contributor-rendering components: src/lib/components/ContributorCard.svelte, ContributorsListModal.svelte, ContributorDetail.svelte, LiveScroll.svelte. Record the exact photo+fallback pattern used by ContributorCard/ContributorsListModal (photoFailed $state, $effect resets on c.photo change, photoFailed=true>, else initials avatar) and confirm ContributorDetail does NOT reference c.photo.

Read all five skins' pages/Home.svelte (aurora, classic, festival, premium, slate) and record for each: does it render contributors as a horizontal rail or a vertical list; are the rows/cards tappable; does it mount ContributorDetail; does it use LiveScroll or the shared ContributorsListModal or its own inline markup.

Grep across src/lib for every horizontal/RTL scroller and animation primitive so nothing is missed: search for `overflow-x`, `translateX`, `marquee`, `requestAnimationFrame`, `scrollLeft`, `scrollBy`, and `LiveScroll`. Record each hit with file and whether it is auto-scroll (live) or manual-only.

Write the findings to .agents/tasks/task-v6-contributor-detail-photo-and-rtl-scroll/ANALYSIS.md with three sections matching the three requirements (photo source list-vs-detail; detail-card open/position per skin; RTL-scroller inventory per skin), plus a short 'proposed approach' paragraph per requirement that later features will implement.
Record the baseline command results and the analysis summary in this feature file's `findings` field.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run check`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` in Public/frontend-v6 all succeed on the untouched checkout, and the results are recorded in findings.

.agents/tasks/task-v6-contributor-detail-photo-and-rtl-scroll/ANALYSIS.md exists and documents: the photo field name and where list vs detail avatars are chosen; how the detail card is opened/positioned in each of the five skins; and a complete inventory of horizontal/RTL scrollers with their per-skin usage.
The analysis explicitly names which skins currently (i) show a photo in the detail card, (ii) can open a detail card at all, and (iii) have a live vs manual horizontal scroller.
verification: Run `export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" && cd Public/frontend-v6 && npm run check && npm test && npm run build` and confirm all pass.
Confirm ANALYSIS.md exists and contains the three required sections.
findings:
BASELINE (untouched checkout, Public/frontend-v6, node v22.23.2 / npm 11.4.2 via nvm PATH prepend): all three CI gates PASS. `npm run check` (svelte-check --fail-on-warnings) => 0 errors, 0 warnings (one benign Vite configLoader 'native' warning about importing ./src/lib/ratings without extension in vite.config.ts — not a svelte-check warning, does not fail the gate). `npm test` (vitest run) => 13 files, 271 tests passed (the `::error::first-load JS ... over budget` and `references missing files` lines are intentional assertions inside firstLoadBytes.test.ts / critical-path.test.ts, not failures). `npm run build` (adapter-static + PWA) => built in ~7.5s, PWA precache 95 entries, wrote build/. Matches recorded expectation (271 tests + build OK). ANALYSIS.md written to .agents/tasks/task-v6-contributor-detail-photo-and-rtl-scroll/ANALYSIS.md, verified against code by reading every file (not copied from context.json). REQ1 (photo field + list vs detail avatar): photo lives in Contributor.photo (derive.ts:158-159, populated at derive.ts:277 from user.Photo, '' when none — no API change needed). Helpers in utils/format.ts: initials() (L38), avatarGradient() (L57), fmt() (L13). List-side photo+fallback reference: ContributorCard.svelte (photoFailed $state, $effect resets on c.photo, photoFailed> else initials, h-11 w-11) and ContributorsListModal.svelte (SvelteSet failedPhotos keyed by key, h-10 w-10); aurora rail also uses the SvelteSet pattern (h-10 w-10). GAP: ContributorDetail.svelte renders ONLY the h-20 w-20 initials gradient avatar and never references c.photo (confirmed by full read). Skins showing a photo in the detail card today: NONE. REQ2 (detail card open/position per skin): ContributorDetail is a hand-rolled sheet (backdrop `fixed inset-0 z-50 ... items-end ... sm:items-center`, panel `rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl`, use:dialog) with NO max-h and NO internal scroll region, and z-50 vs Modal.svelte's z-[60] + max-h-[85vh] + inner overflow-y-auto — the likely cause of the reported overflow/mis-anchoring. Only PREMIUM opens the detail card (LiveScroll onselect -> selected -> ). aurora mounts only ContributorsListModal (rail tiles are plain
, not tappable; list-modal rows also not tappable). classic/festival/slate are vertical text lists with search+tabs, rows are plain
, no ContributorDetail import. Skins that can open a detail card today: ONLY premium. REQ3 (RTL/horizontal scroller inventory): grep of src/lib for overflow-x/translateX/translate3d/marquee/requestAnimationFrame/scrollLeft/scrollBy/LiveScroll. Only TWO horizontal scrollers: (A) LiveScroll.svelte = LIVE auto-scroll (rAF drives scrollLeft += 0.6px/frame, duplicated track seamless loop, prev/pause/next, pauses on hover/touch/hidden/reduced-motion) used ONLY by premium; (B) aurora/pages/Home.svelte inline `overflow-x-auto` rail = MANUAL only (no rAF/scrollLeft/scrollBy/controls). classic/festival/slate have NO horizontal scroller. Other rAF hits are NOT scrollers: dialog.ts:152 (one-shot focus) and CountUp.svelte:33,35 (number animation). No translateX/translate3d/marquee anywhere. Live vs manual today: premium=live, aurora=manual, classic/festival/slate=none. Proposed approaches recorded in ANALYSIS.md for FEAT-002 (add shared photo+fallback to ContributorDetail keeping h-20 w-20; give it Modal-style max-h + internal scroll; route tap-to-open through shared ContributorsListModal + each skin's rows) and FEAT-003 (convert aurora's manual rail to shared LiveScroll; classic/festival/slate have no horizontal rail to make live). No product code changed in FEAT-001.
